lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action

findings.observation: Confirmed defect: if saving the superseded terminal state fails, the store restores the prior pending value and protects it only with transientSupersededEvidenceReviewKeys. A new AgentSessionStore initializes that transient set empty, while Ask exposes Reconcile safely for any restored pending operation that is not in flight. Therefore a process relaunch after this exact persistence failure re-exposes the obsolete retry path. The current-session mutations to pending, applied, failed, or outcome_unknown are correctly blocked; the defect is specifically the failed-terminal-save plus relaunch boundary. The backend's exact current-last-review check still rejects the obsolete operation, so the frozen evidence does not show a stale canonical mutation or duplicate review.
findings.evidence: Direct frozen source: apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipArchiveModels.swift:323-360 initializes transientSupersededEvidenceReviewKeys empty on restore; :670-689 rolls a failed terminal save back to the prior stored operation and adds only an in-memory transient key; :941-965 restores the prior value when persistence fails. apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipAskView.swift:1246-1260 renders Reconcile safely for pending and non-in-flight operations, and :696-727 sends the same review operation after markEvidenceReviewPending. The frozen test apps/ios/Tests/RelationshipArchiveTests.swift:367-417 proves only the current-store transient guard and leaves the stored state pending; unlike :294-364, it does not recreate the store after the failed save. Containment is direct in apps/backend/src/modules/resources.ts:95-117 and :564-590, while evidence/backend-check/evidence-review-authority-runtime.json records stale_replay_rejected=true and persisted_authority_chain_verified=true.
findings.user_impact: After a storage failure and relaunch, a recruiter can be invited to retry a source decision that the product already knows was superseded. The server should reject it, so candidate evidence is not silently rewritten, but the stale control creates avoidable requests, repeated conflict handling, and an untruthful recovery affordance at a sensitive evidence decision.
findings.recommendation: Make restored evidence-review operations fail closed until current canonical authority is revalidated. If a terminal tombstone cannot be saved, a later launch must not enable POST from the old pending record: quarantine it behind a current-authority readback or equivalent restart-safe marker, hide Reconcile safely, and offer only a fresh scoped Ask unless the server proves that exact operation is still current.
findings.verification: Inject failure while persisting EVIDENCE_REVIEW_AUTHORITY_STALE, destroy and recreate AgentSessionStore, reopen the same Session, and assert that the old operation cannot be claimed, no Reconcile safely control appears, and zero evidence-review POSTs occur. Then restore storage, verify Ask with current evidence preserves a nonempty draft, and prove the canonical fragment remains on the later review ID.

findings.criterion: Evaluator reliability and frozen evidence closure
findings.observation: Confirmed review-package defect: the frozen P0 manifest depends on runtime JSON and screenshots under earlier v1-prd-02, v1-prd-04, v1-prd-05, v1-prd-06, v1-prd-07, v1-prd-08, and v1-prd-09 directories that are not enumerated in this artifact's evidence or screenshot manifests. The frozen p0-journey-runtime.json nevertheless reports 69 assertions and 12/12 journeys passed. Those claims may have been valid when generated, but an independent reviewer constrained to this freeze cannot hash-validate or replay all of them. This does not negate the separately frozen deletion, authority-chain, iOS-suite, Pursuit, and Agent evidence used for this safety verdict.
findings.evidence: Direct frozen bundle: evidence/p0-journey-manifest.json:22-54, :68-70, :82-109, :146-148, :182, :209-211, and later journeys reference prior evaluation paths outside the retest-03 freeze; evidence/p0-journey-runtime.json:7-15 reports pass, 12/12, and 69 assertions while also disclosing live Agent status not_run_missing_credentials. artifact.json evidence_manifest begins at line 916 and hashes only 14 retest-03 runtime artifacts, while frozen_visual_evidence contains only the 21 retest-03 screenshots. Hash validation of those enumerated 195 source files, 14 runtime artifacts, and 21 screenshots succeeded with zero mismatches.
findings.user_impact: A release reviewer can over-read the 12/12 P0 headline as a self-contained frozen proof even though part of its oracle graph is outside the hash boundary. That weakens reproducibility and makes later evidence drift harder to detect.
findings.recommendation: Either copy and hash every P0 source and file dependency into this frozen artifact or rewrite the P0 manifest so every assertion resolves to a retest-03 artifact. Make the capture validator fail when any assertion source or declared file is absent from artifact.evidence_manifest or artifact.frozen_visual_evidence.
findings.verification: Traverse every journeys[].assertions[].source and journeys[].files[] entry, require the normalized path and SHA-256 to exist in the artifact manifests, then rerun the P0 evaluator from a checkout containing only the frozen dependency set; all 69 assertions must still pass.

strengths: Direct hash verification passed for all 195 product-source entries, all 14 runtime-evidence artifacts, all 21 screenshots, and the aggregate source digest; no reviewed frozen object drifted.

Deletion is materially stronger than a UI label: the backend supersedes open Proposals, redacts Proposal summary, before/proposed/decided values, reason, effect, review reason, operation reason, audit reason, evidence-review reason, and idempotency response bodies. The synthetic canary is absent from Proposal, item, operation, idempotency, audit, and fragment stores; post-delete readback keeps only the applied business value plus confirmer/time/Proposal/Receipt while authority becomes unavailable. typed-signal-deletion.png also ties visible success to server-confirmed deletion before removing the local payload.

Same-name identity is not resolved by display name: the backend evidence creates two distinct Person IDs and an unresolved resolution case, and the passed iOS journey plus same-name-binding-receipt.png expose relationship context, a stable Person clue, and full Person/role/context IDs in the receipt.

Evidence review uses an exact predecessor chain. The server locks current fragment/resource/capture authorization, compares expected_review_status and expected_last_review_id, persists monotonic same-fragment revisions with a foreign-key predecessor, accepts same-cycle replay only while its resulting review remains current, and rejects an old replay after a later review. The iOS client validates fragment, prior review ID, resulting review ID, decision, and timestamp before showing applied state.

Proposal and owned-action response loss remain visibly outcome-unknown and locked, then reconcile by the exact durable operation ID and canonical readback. Frozen screenshots show no success during ambiguity and show empty external effects after reconciliation; the iOS full-suite artifact directly requires the one-POST Proposal and action recovery journeys and the mismatched-receipt fail-closed test.

Within one live Session, active evidence-review ownership prevents double submit, a transient superseded guard blocks pending/applied/failed/outcome_unknown mutation after a terminal save failure, and Ask with current evidence preserves a nonempty draft. A successfully persisted superseded state also survives relaunch and exposes no old retry.

Temporal authority follows the latest mutation rather than equal values: a newer recruiter-authored B remains user-authored after deletion of an older evidence-backed B, while an applied evidence-backed milestone preserves the historical decision and explicitly degrades its current authority.

Agent authority is narrow and review-only: the frozen deterministic evaluator passes 30/30 trials across supported Proposal, no_action, prompt-injection denial, malformed output, budget exhaustion, and source-deleted-after-snapshot cases; only read_pursuit, read_evidence, stage_pursuit_proposal, and record_no_action are allowed, all external_effects arrays are empty, and staged output remains needs_review rather than confirmed state.
missing_evidence: Complete manual VoiceOver traversal by a human, plus physical-device accessibility behavior for the critical journey.
Physical-device Action Button, microphone, interruption, permission-change, and system-capture privacy behavior.
Five credentialed live Claude Agent SDK trials against this exact frozen evaluator and pinned model; the frozen live artifact is explicitly not_run_missing_credentials / missing_proof.

Production authentication, authorization, regional storage, retention, export, deletion, provider reconciliation, and adversarial cross-tenant testing; current isolation proof is synthetic local PostgreSQL and Simulator evidence.
Deletion propagation through production backups, analytics, logs, observability, caches/vector stores, vendors, and model-training controls, including restoration and monitored erasure evidence.

One integrated evidence-review test that combines HTTP response loss, a later competing review, terminal-save failure, process relaunch, rendered retry controls, POST counting, and canonical readback. The frozen evidence currently proves these seams separately.
Human-gold calibration, swapped-order repeats, adversarial counterexamples, and drift monitoring for the model-based review/evaluation process.
Design-partner recruiter comparison and authorized candidate-side research; no production, field, candidate-trust, or outcome claim is supported by this freeze.
open_questions: What restart-time canonical preflight or fail-closed quarantine will distinguish a legitimate response-loss pending operation from one whose superseded terminal state could not be persisted?
Will the final PR make the P0 dependency graph self-contained and hash-addressed, or narrow the 12/12 claim to only the assertions inside the retest-03 freeze?

Which production stores and subprocessors will receive deletion events, how will completion be verified, and what evidence will prove backup/analytics/vendor erasure without introducing real candidate data into evaluation?
